title: Built a market conditions indicator (FREE)
author: No_Page5992
selftext:
Hi guys, 

I've been building a free TradingView indicator called '' OrcaTrading - Market Conditions V2''  
And I'd love some honest feedback from other traders for improvement.

This tool will forever remain free, I am not trying to sell anything here. Just trying to collect some extra and external feedback.

What is it?

The idea of this indicator is to help the trader to solve a fairly simple question:  
'' Should I even be looking for trades right now? ''

Instead of creating a entry focused indicator, I focused on market quality, which is what I believe many traders fail to determine.

I see traders often take trades simply because they see their setup forming, not taking in consideration about overall market environment.

A A+ setup in a bad quality market is still a bad trade.

Full explanation of how the indicator works is in the description!

If you have any question now, feel free to ask.
